text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A and Stock E after large gains reduced my exposure, but I should judge trims by portfolio risk and goals, not by the satisfaction of realizing a profit.","After the account fell in recent periods, I should avoid panic-selling or doubling down just to defend past decisions; neither gains nor losses make a purchase a mistake by themselves.","Because price changes are random, I should not infer a trend from this short record; use a consistent plan for position sizing and review it calmly rather than trading frequently out of regret or impatience."]}
